scripts.build:skill: bun build skills/souq/harajcli/src/bin.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile skills/souq/scripts/haraj.mjs && bun build skills/souq/aqarcli/src/bin.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile skills/souq/scripts/aqar.mjs && cp skills/souq/harajcli/haraj.config.json skills/souq/haraj.config.json && cp skills/souq/aqarcli/aqar.config.json skills/souq/aqar.config.json
scripts.check: bun run check:haraj && bun run check:aqar
scripts.test: bun run build:skill && bun run test:haraj && bun run test:aqar && node --test test/packaged-runners.test.mjs
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run test && bun run build:haraj && bun run build:aqar
